tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List all pstack skills with short name, category and one-line description. Use first to discover what is available. Filter by category when you already know the kind of skill needed.

category.description: Filter by category. Use 'all' to list everything.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search skills by keyword or short phrase (e.g. 'bug fix', 'parallel design', 'remove comments', 'prove it works'). Returns matching skill names with short reasons.

query.description: Keyword or short description of what you need.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get one skill by exact name. Use 'summary' for a short usable brief, or 'full' for the complete SKILL.md content. Call this after list_skills, search_skills or recommend_skills.

mode.description: summary = short usable brief; full = complete SKILL.md text.

tools.name: recommend_skills
tools.description: Given a task description, recommend the most relevant 1-5 skills to load right now. Best entry point for small models: describe what you are doing and get the skills you need.

task.description: What the agent is currently trying to do, in plain language.

limit.description: Max number of skills to recommend.

tools.name: get_principles
tools.description: List all 24 engineering principles, or fetch specific ones by name. Principles are short decision rules (e.g. prove-it-works, laziness-protocol). Prefer this when you only need principles, not full workflow skills.

names.description: Optional list of principle names (with or without 'principle-' prefix). Omit to list all.

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: Get one poteto-mode playbook by name (the 23 task-type playbooks). Use when you already know the task type (bug-fix, feature, investigation, etc.).
